Type: shelf
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Hexagon Honeycomb Floating Wall Shelf Unit with Glass Shelves - 28 x 28 x 6 Inch, Gold
Materials: Glass
This wall unit offers a modern take on shelving with 5 shelves cleverly integrated into an elegant honeycomb design. The glass shelves are held in place by 3 connected gold-colored iron hexagons. 28.35"H x 27.95"W x 5.91"D 95% iron; 5% glass Shelf unit Avoid moisture. This item wipes clean with a soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware is included.
